title: Define and implement the managed data root and configuration contract
action: Define and implement the managed data root and configuration contract: an OS-appropriate external default root (Windows %LOCALAPPDATA%\AIEH\, Linux per XDG), resolved through an established cross-platform path library or the platform conventions, with three top-level lifecycle categories beneath it, persistent/ (durable workspaces, databases, credentials, authorization records, configuration and operational evidence), ephemeral/ (disposable scratch, temporary execution artifacts, caches and regenerable intermediate files) and assets/ (downloaded, reusable, verified artifacts such as pinned model weights, VM base images, installation packages and third-party distributions, each retaining version, provenance, integrity metadata and enough information to reacquire it, deleted only deliberately and reclaimable only when no required consumer depends on it and verified reacquisition is possible), with base images kept distinct from mutable VM disks and overlays, which belong in persistent/ or ephemeral/ by lifecycle; the optional AIEH_DATA_ROOT override, absolute or relative, a relative override resolving against the repository root, never the cwd; a data root inside or containing the source checkout is refused; a tracked example_config.yml and an optional, gitignored config.yml for non-secret settings and per-directory overrides, a relative directory override resolving against the effective root; deterministic precedence of a per-directory override, then AIEH_DATA_ROOT, then the OS default; one shared resolver with thin adapters across language and process boundaries; an evaluation of dotenv as optional convenience only; no secrets in tracked or source-accessible configuration.

title: Build the Owner authorization recorder
action: Build the deterministic, non-model Owner authorization recorder and exercise it on the S-01.2.2 fixture. It is the sole custodian of cred-gitea-owner-account, authenticates as aieh-owner with basic auth held in memory per call, never mints a token, never uses sudo, force_merge or auto-merge, makes merge commits only, has no agent-callable or MCP surface, and runs only in the main session on an Owner decision. prepare <repo> <pr> writes a challenge (operation, PR, exact head, manifest digest, nonce and expiry) to the recorder's own state; record --challenge --statement refuses, each with a stable code, unless authenticity (its own unexpired, unconsumed nonce; an Owner-attributed statement naming the operation id; an admitted channel), binding (an open PR against the protected branch; head and manifest blob digest equal to the challenged ones; the manifest is the single file operations/<id>.json; a new operation id; an author other than aieh-owner), freshness (both expiries unpassed; the PR mergeable), policy (the protection and repository rules exactly as expected), identity (aieh-owner non-admin with zero tokens) and single use all hold. It writes the Owner decision record in the shared shape (kind authorize-operation) and a write-ahead receipt of a new append-only kind to the integration store, never the effects store; merges with Do: merge and head_commit_id, the message carrying the trailers AIEH-Decision-Id, AIEH-Decision-Channel, AIEH-Approved-Head, AIEH-Manifest-Digest, AIEH-Statement-Ref and AIEH-Recorder; reads back the ref, the parent, the digest and merged_by; and resolves a lost answer as unknown by reading the ref, never by merging again. The bootstrap channel is the Owner's verbatim reply in the main-session conversation after the challenge is shown, transcribed by the Overseer and logged with the decision id; it proves a declared decision bound to an exact revision, not an authenticated Owner. merged_by aieh-owner is shown as merged under Owner authority by the recorder on decision <id>, never as merged by the Owner. Update security/inventory.json (an authorization-recorder principal as custodian of cred-gitea-owner-account; op-protected-merge keeps principal owner with the recorder as delegated performer; fd-owner-authorization-record narrowed) and policy/role-tokens.json (the owner row's realization and issuance text, and a custodian row); record decision 0012 and a blueprint reconciliation item for #experience step 16 and the #decisions phrase 'no automation merge'.
